outputs.explanation: The lower bar graph in panel A shows mean ± SD of HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto, N=4 mice, n>100 cells) as bars with error bars only, without overlaid individual data points.
The lower bar graph in panel B shows mean ± SD of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (N=4 mice, n>400 cells) with error bars but no individual data points overlaid.
Panel C is a western blot, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod across weeks); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod performance across days at 5w/9w/21w); line plots are exempt from the requirement.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (a line plot type); exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G contains only micrograph images with no averaged/quantified plot data.
Both bar graphs in panel H (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number, N=3 mice, n=9 fields) show mean ± SD only, with no individual data points overlaid.
